scope: Independent visual and mechanical-export-readiness review of the 12 current root-generated identity and background masters. No source or master artwork was edited.

route_authorization.basis: W02 root-authorized route supplied with the current masters for batch12 review.
route_authorization.review_boundary: This receipt records visual and export-readiness findings. It does not replace the source-generation records, assert a separate Astra or image-backend attestation, grant rights clearance, or approve publication.

source_hash_check.dimensions_and_modes: 12/12 selected dimensions and modes match root-generation-index.json

visual_checks: Viewed all 12 native masters with view_image.
Viewed intended-size crops or resizes for identity exports and background exports under /tmp/w02-root-art-review.
Checked ID-05 at 96, 48, and 24 px; ID-06 at 64, 32, and 16 px; and ID-07 at 48 and 24 px.
Checked BG-04 as 800 px tiles and as 2x2 visual repeats.
method.negative_case: The BG-04 repeat check looked for edge-crossing motifs and tonal seams; the ID-08 typography check compared visible font captions with the canonical brand guide.

summary.decision: Proceed with mechanical exports for the 11 ready assets, retaining the BG-04 repeat caveat. Hold ID-08 until its font caption is corrected in a new authored master or the intended specimen content is otherwise explicitly revised and re-reviewed.

assets.title: Branching-A mark
observations: The wide source is a clean two-panel pair of equal square marks. The left variant retains the amber ascending branch and the right variant is a dark monochrome mark.
Both variants remain clear in the 64 px review previews and are safe to split at the midpoint.
mechanical_notes: Slice the 887x887 left and right panels, then resize each to 64x64.
The source is an opaque paper-backed RGB pair by design; preserve the paper background and do not require alpha for this export.
limits: The source pair is not a transparent overlay.
assets.rejected_prior_attempts: Root index records ID-01 generations 2 and 3 as rejected_painted_checkerboard; they are excluded from this review.

assets.title: Organization wordmark
observations: The light and dark horizontal bands slice cleanly, with consistent centered lockups and broad safe margins.
The visible organization name is spelled AI Ascension and remains high contrast in the reviewed central crop.
mechanical_notes: Split the top and bottom bands, then use the reviewed central 1200x220 crop for each variant.

assets.title: Flagship product lockup
observations: The light and dark bands slice cleanly with a consistent mark, product word, and attribution layout.
Ascension and by AI Ascension are visibly spelled correctly in the reviewed central crop.
mechanical_notes: Split the two 362 px bands and use the reviewed central 1000x220 crop for each variant.

assets.title: The Climb title lockup
observations: The Climb and by AI Ascension are correct and readable, with the amber path accent subordinate to the title.
The centered vertical crop retains the title, attribution, mark, and paper clearspace.
mechanical_notes: Use the reviewed 1400x400 central vertical crop, then resize or encode the two required exports as directed by the asset registry.

assets.title: Organization avatar set
observations: The dark square avatar has a strong ivory branching A with a restrained amber branch and generous square and circular crop safety.
The mark remains recognizable at 96, 48, and 24 px; fine branch detail compresses at 24 px without losing the primary silhouette.
mechanical_notes: Resize the centered square source to 1024 and 256 px without recoloring.
limits: Use adjacent labels when the 24 px placement needs more semantic detail than the silhouette provides.

assets.title: Browser and app icon set
observations: The simplified dark and amber mark has a decisive open upward A silhouette with no hairline details that disappear in the reviewed sizes.
The 64, 32, and 16 px previews remain category-recognizable on the light ground.
mechanical_notes: Resize the centered source to the four registry dimensions and preserve the opaque paper ground.

assets.title: Product and evidence icon sprite
observations: The source is a regular 2x5 sheet with the requested ten labels: Play, Record, Replay, Code, Evidence, Warning, Unavailable, External link, Privacy, and Intervention.

The 48 px slices are readable. At 24 px the symbols remain category-distinguishable, although Replay, Code, Unavailable, External link, Privacy, and Intervention are soft and should sit beside visible text labels.
mechanical_notes: Resize the sheet to the registry size and slice only along the reviewed 2x5 cell boundaries; do not redraw, relabel, or recolor symbols.
limits: The 24 px slices should not carry the full meaning without an adjacent text label.

assets.title: Design token and typography specimen
observations: The specimen is visually polished and the requested AI Ascension, Ascent Ledger, palette, spacing, button-state, footer, and evidence language are readable.
The mono font caption visibly reads Geist Mono. The canonical brand guide and token contract require JetBrains Mono for identifiers and evidence labels.

issues.finding: Visible specimen copy says Geist Mono while the canonical type reference is JetBrains Mono.
issues.required_follow_up: Obtain a corrected authored master or an explicitly revised specimen source, then re-review the visible copy before exporting specimen.png or treating specimen.html as complete.

mechanical_notes: The 1122x1402 source ratio is close to the 1600x2000 target and can be resized mechanically after the copy defect is resolved.

assets.title: Editorial ascent environment master
observations: The warm paper environment keeps the left side broad and quiet while concentrating branching ink and amber geometry on the right.
No text, game scene, result, evidence graphic, or publisher mark is visible; the target ratio matches the source ratio.
mechanical_notes: Resize to 2400x1600 while preserving the left title-safe area and right-side composition.

assets.title: Dark broadcast atmosphere master
observations: The near-black atmosphere is quiet through the left and center, with the amber branching form kept at the far right.
No text, scoreboard, game art, provider logo, or fabricated result is visible; the slight source-to-target ratio difference is safe for a mechanical crop or resize.
mechanical_notes: Resize or make the minimal aspect-ratio crop needed for 2560x1440 while retaining the quiet left and center.

assets.title: Series interstitial texture
observations: The upper area is a broad quiet warm-paper field, with restrained ink and amber branching contours confined to the lower portion.
No text, logo, game map, or evidence claim is visible; the square source is crop-safe for the square target.
mechanical_notes: Resize the square source to 2160x2160 without changing the composition.

assets.title: Light/dark route pattern
observations: The source contains two sparse square decorative panels with matching branching motifs, and the 800 px crops show no hard motif cut or edge-crossing branch.
The 2x2 repeat inspection is visually usable, but the generated paper and near-black fields are not mathematically uniform at every edge.
mechanical_notes: Split the two 887x887 panels and resize each to 800x800 without recoloring or redrawing the motifs.
limits: A faint broad tonal seam remains visible in 2x2 repeats, especially at the dark tile's central vertical join. Edge-wrap RGB absolute differences were approximately 3.7 at the immediate light-tile join and 24.1 at the immediate dark-tile join, decaying across wider strips.
Use this export where a visually subtle repeat is acceptable. A strict mathematically seamless tile still needs a new authored source and a fresh review.

unverified_or_deferred: Generation backend identity, Astra runtime attestation, and rights clearance remain governed by the source and approval records.
No generated artwork is product evidence, gameplay evidence, or proof of a model result.
Publication approval, responsive browser placement, accessibility contrast in every consuming surface, and final export hashes remain downstream checks after mechanical export.
